# Using MultiJetBinning for "JetGood" counting
jet_multiplicity_binning = MultiJetBinning(

    cuts=[

        ("5j", 5, 5),      # exactly 5 jets
        ("6+j", 6, None),  # at least 6 jets
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning

    name="nBtags_binning",
    cuts=[
        ("2b", 2, 2),      # exactly 2 b-tags
        ("3+b", 3, None),  # at least 3 b-tags
    ]
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
analysis_categories = CartesianProduct(
    name="analysis_cats",
    binnings=[jet_multiplicity_binning, btag_multiplicity_binning]
)

config = {
    "categorization": analysis_categories
